long_biography.plain_text:
Collecting became one of Kazuo Akao’s most visible public legacies. After succeeding the first director of the Century Cultural Foundation, he established the Century Museum and worked with scholar Shigemi Komatsu to assemble calligraphy, painting, classical books and decorative arts. The 2,325-title Century Akao Collection was donated to Keio University in 2021.

Architecture offered a second expression of that cultural interest. Akao developed a long collaboration with Norman Foster, commissioning offices and houses that joined modern glass and steel with principles drawn from traditional Japanese space. He involved himself closely in design, function, materials and cost.
